payload.summary: Planned a coordinated breaking migration that unifies source dispatch, canonical content provenance, durable PostgreSQL operations, and CLI/HTTP/MCP/frontend workflows. Gate 1 selected the domain registry and durable workflows approach; strict OpenSpec and package validations pass.

decisions.title: Use executable source registry
decisions.rationale: One descriptor owns typed dispatch, scheduling, discovery, and surface coverage for every source.

decisions.title: Resolve canonical summarized content once
decisions.rationale: Immutable half-open published-date selections and fingerprints prevent theme, digest, and podcast provenance drift.

decisions.title: Use pgqueuer_jobs for every long mutation
decisions.rationale: The existing durable queue supplies one operation ledger, idempotency, progress, retry, and cancellation without a second store.

decisions.title: Coordinate a breaking cross-interface cutover
decisions.rationale: All controlled clients can converge on discriminated commands, structured operations, and generated frontend contracts without legacy adapters.

next_steps: Start wp-contracts, then execute the validated dependency DAG.
